brief:
Middle East Eye reported that Israeli forces attacked Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis on November 12, killing six Palestinians and injuring dozens more. The strike marked another escalation in military operations across the enclave.

The outlet's analysis examined why international solidarity movements and demonstrations have failed to prevent or significantly slow Israeli military operations in Gaza, suggesting structural barriers to translating public support into concrete policy shifts.
dek: Opinion: Why solidarity with Gaza failed to stop the genocide On 12 November, Israel attacked Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis, killing six Palestinians and injuring dozens more.
title: Israel kills six at Gaza hospital as solidarity fails to halt war
